method: Same six features and hard guards; optional length-3/4/5/6/7/8+ additive logit constants. Regularized toward the accepted shared rule. TRAIN fit/calibration; selection excludes evaluation. 24 joint-refit trials plus 12 direct cutoff/shrinkage trials; no evaluation used to select. Selection prioritizes unambiguous 4/5-letter F0.5, requires preserved overall real selection F0.5. Synthetic word/observation groups disjoint; exposed 3,000 types excluded.
